answer: One anti-Sybil mechanism is slashable stake-weighted attestation: an agent must lock a bond before its verdict counts, and any verdict later proven false burns that bond. The trust bridge between agents carries only attestations whose author has collateral, so a fabricated identity cannot signal honesty for free. Each extra Sybil therefore needs its own locked stake, so the attacker's cost rises linearly with every fake name. Without that economic anchor, forged reputation would survive as a relic of the first impersonation.
